intro.title: Try the decisions.
intro.lead: Four decisions from my case studies, rebuilt small enough to play with. They run on sample data, and none of them is the real product.

pieces.title: Delete or quarantine?
pieces.prompt: Pick the broken records, then choose. After that, try restoring one.

pieces.title: Name your price
pieces.prompt: Move your offer below the suggestion and see what happens when nobody says yes.
pieces.note: Sample numbers. The real price logic is not set.

pieces.title: Pause or emergency stop?
pieces.prompt: Move your hand with the slider. Then pause the arm, stop it, and try the Space bar.
pieces.note: A pretend arm. The real one is not connected to this page.

pieces.title: What the RSVP button says
pieces.prompt: Switch the event between states and watch the button and the line under it change.

site.title: Also on this site
site.lead: Smaller things I built for this site and kept.

tiles.title: Polaroid pile
tiles.text: Shuffle a small pile of photos, like the one on Gatherings.

tiles.title: Note wall queue
tiles.text: Approve or hide a note before it goes public. The real queue sits behind a password.

tiles.title: Press T to talk
tiles.text: A keyboard shortcut that opens the talk panel from anywhere on this site.

footer.heading: Have an idea I should try?
